title: Sua loi Tag danh so lien tiep bi nhay linh tinh khi chon tu trai sang phai
scope: Khac phuc loi danh so lien tiep tren thanh TAG khi nguoi dung chon doi tuong tu trai sang phai
Ho tro sap xep theo dung toa do thuc te tu trai sang phai (kem dung sai gom nhom theo hang Y / Row Banding) hoac giu dung thu tu nguoi dung click chon tung doi tuong (Pick Order)
Dam bao anh xa row.id voi Attribute/Block trong snapshot khong bi xao tron thu tu
Bien dich qua build_v4.cmd va kiem thu native accoreconsole
out_of_scope: Cac tinh nang khac cua module MEPS
acceptance_criteria: Khi chon cac block/tag tu trai sang phai, cac so duoc danh tang dan chinh xac theo dung chieu tu trai sang phai
Khong bi hien tuong nhay linh tinh / zic-zac giua cac hang khi quet chon
Kiem thu native tren AutoCAD hoac accoreconsole dat 100% PASS
Dong goi ban cai dat V12 vao OUTPUT/12. TVXD.BG V12
